entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent memory provider available as an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server or a managed cloud service.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes Agent context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs. It utilizes a three-tier loading system (L0/L1/L2) and session archiving to achieve significant token reduction and task-completion gains.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: This open-source platform enables persistent long-term memory for agents through a self-hosted knowledge graph engine built from text and code. It features automatic routing to handle graph, vector, and code retrieval across multiple agent sessions.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain builds a knowledge graph with typed edges to store facts with full provenance and support for memory withdrawal. It generates synthesized answers that include citations, gap analysis, and entity relationship mapping.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider, this engine sustains sub-300ms recall at high scale using a custom vector graph engine and byte-level deduplication. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and offers connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows for agents, supporting over 25 LLM providers including local models. The system is accessible via Python and Node.js SDKs and can be deployed through Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: This memory library serves as the upstream foundation for Hermes self-hosted wrappers, offering a reasoning-first approach that extracts conclusions from conversation history. It is implemented as a FastAPI server with support for local CLI execution and managed hosting.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent memory provider treats context as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms performance and includes an interactive TUI.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Designed for Hermes Agents, this zero-dependency system provides sub-millisecond memory operations using only a pure-Python dependency and SQLite. It features episodic compression to ensure sub-linear storage growth and supports MCP and native tool integrations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes a local infrastructure of Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage structured facts and vector search. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize specific injected contexts and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that stores immutable context bundles and outcome-gated data in the filesystem. It helps agents succeed on complex tasks by iterating through executions to retain useful lessons and artifacts.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin for Hermes Agent uses a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specialized recall tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to help agents recover specific details from persistent message history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes existing local history from over twenty coding agents to enable millisecond lookups across gigabytes of past session data. It prioritizes security by redacting keys and tokens during the indexing process, allowing users to search months of historical interactions already stored on disk.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session persistence for Hermes Agent using an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It is designed for flexibility, supporting any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML files to ensure local ownership and transparency. It utilizes a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25 and embedding search, with native support for MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer maintains a living semantic ontology through a background dreaming process to achieve high accuracy in long-term memory benchmarks. It supports real-time ingestion from platforms like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub to provide portable state across multiple agent clients.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates via MCP and specific agent hooks, utilizing hybrid BM25 and vector search to manage memory on the user's hardware.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This SQLite-backed system provides durable long-term memory through a five-tier hierarchical schema and FTS5 search without requiring vector databases or embedding models. The five-package family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and supports Linux, macOS, and Windows environments.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference while preserving accuracy.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by tagging every retrieved result with a 'why_retrieved' marker and tracking memory contradictions through first-class primitives. It supports an embedded in-process backend, making it suitable for serverless deployments that require self-maintaining memory.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as a source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It avoids opaque databases in favor of a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, integrating with coding agents via MCP servers.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI serves as a machine interface for agent-driven knowledge maintenance, allowing agents to autonomously recall and evolve persistent information. It preserves citations and temporal memory without vector databases and supports portable archives for merging data between stores.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and storing data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server that utilizes GGUF models via node-llama-cpp to provide proactive RAG capabilities.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack functions as a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver a purpose-built evidence packet for every agent query.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This memory layer resolves live workspace states into verified context files to reduce prompt token usage by up to 94%. It provides local-first session history tracking and supports MCP-native integration via stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system utilizes semantic search, BM25 full-text ranking, and graph traversal to manage agent knowledge. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and uses edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: Designed to reduce schema overhead, this tool uses local BM25 ranking to select relevant keywords for Hermes Agent v0.14.0. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings during tool search operations.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed context layer manages workflows for coding agents using hash-checked proposals and receipts for reviewed updates. It offers a source-neutral migration path for exporting chats and documents across supported platforms.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database to store memories with a 1-10 importance ranking. It prioritizes high-value information during context prefetch using BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation for transparency.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to manage budget-bound wallets and process x402 payments using stablecoins across multiple blockchain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys for streamlined financial transactions.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local artifacts such as scripts, cron jobs, and documentation to facilitate capability routing. It registers five native tools for searching and fetching artifacts while automatically generating tool routing notes.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: Providing durable cross-session memory, this plugin uses a local SQLite reliability layer and write outbox for state management. It supports pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots to maintain continuity.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for agents. It features configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory through deterministic slash commands for searching and syncing repositories. It requires a local server for indexing and supports LLM-callable tools for grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory provider features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon, incorporating MinHash deduplication for data integrity.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It supports message compression with automatic context checkpointing to maintain continuity during long-running agent tasks.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based kit manages agent memory through a git-backed directory of markdown files, utilizing 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting information. It operates without a database, providing five slash commands to capture, recall, and propose evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to enable autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first system for generating web, mobile, and motion graphic artifacts with native support for the Hermes Agent runtime. It exports designs to formats including HTML, PDF, and MP4, utilizing the DeepSeek Harness for integration.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library provides 818 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. It is designed for compatibility across more than 26 AI platforms to support 34 security domains.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and offers both a CLI and an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, ERC-7710 permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router, vendored protocol skills, and a dedicated layer for verification and dispute resolution.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a 112-entry word replacement table. It supports rewrite and detect-only modes and is compatible with Claude Code, OpenClaw, and agentskills.io agents.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution by automating deduplication and quality improvements across sessions. It features a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and Claude Code.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and Codex agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,169 professional and life task skills distributed as plain markdown files under the MIT license. The skills run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code, with export options available for other assistants.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill enables video search, transcript extraction, and playlist browsing for Hermes Agent and other coding assistants. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and provides access to channel-level data.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python plugin scaffolds, managed via integrated slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project provides skills that allow Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts. It includes pre-built domain lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project enables type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It provides tools for reading bundled resources and executing untrusted scripts within a sandboxed environment to isolate them from the host.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: These skills transform rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs for Hermes Agent. The workflow features Lite and Full modes for varying project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill allows agents to weave prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs source file edits back to the original literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Operating as a local-first system using Git and SQLite, this harness manages cooperative-agent teams via the SLP protocol. It is written in TypeScript and runs on Bun, facilitating structured memory and cross-feature learning without background services.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory through markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models, allowing an agent to effectively train its own successor.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides installation guides and integrations for Hermes Agent specifically in Portuguese. It offers a collection of skills in the SKILL.md format that adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable agent discovery and activation for oracle network interactions. The package supports integrations for CCIP, Data Feeds, VRF, and Data Streams via the Vercel open skills ecosystem CLI.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This official suite provides specialist skills for FLUX image and video generation, including prompting guidelines and BFL API integration. It supports polling and webhooks for media generation tasks, including a dedicated FLUX 3 video suite.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It features automated workflows for briefing, testing, and exporting skills while linking instructions to specific file lines or URLs.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It includes a Python client, a CLI, and commerce features powered by TON payments.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika defines AI workflows as code using a YAML-based language with four verbs and a single Rust binary. The local-first CLI allows users to check, run, and trace task execution across OpenAI and Codex models.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for complex multi-step tasks, this skill enables autonomous execution with real-time progress and decision tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in rollback procedures and checkpoints for recovery from failures.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and includes a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification for autonomous 24/7 operation. It integrates federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face to facilitate one-click skill installation.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project provides a five-layer intelligent retrieval system that uses hard triggers and semantic embeddings to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering relevant skills, it reduces token usage and offers graceful degradation if specific embedding models are unavailable.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed as an ADHD-friendly execution system, this project uses MCP connections to allow Hermes Agent to manage habits, study blocks, and scheduling. Data is stored locally in a single SQLite file, accessible via both a React web app and an Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security skill employs three parallel subagents to perform adversarial bug-hunting and edge-case analysis on code. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes Hermes Agent prompts across multiple interfaces like Discord and Telegram, achieving a 20–80% reduction in token usage. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a trio of agents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in languages such as Python, Go, and Rust. It employs a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It includes a Python-based goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during complex debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST, to handle real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide session management to maintain memory between agent conversations and tools for worktree recovery. The project also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and state drift detection.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent through 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It operates with a strict read-only boundary and zero outbound telemetry to ensure data privacy.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible demo GIFs for repositories using vhs or Playwright. It handles rendering, optimizes files to stay under 8 MB, and embeds the resulting markdown directly into the README.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills from plain language while ensuring they adhere to current frontmatter specifications. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to detect and report any drift from official standards.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify skill gaps and propose structured updates. It gates all changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators to ensure quality before updates are applied.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set provides deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new software installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols like x402 and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to prove a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for creating bounty boards and buying context, with 85% of the payout going to the winning contributor.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator creates structured reports from global to street-level scales with integrated AI analysis. It uses semantic memory to align search results with specific user interests and provides actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection features specialized tools for transcribing Douyin videos, performing OCR on Chinese documents, and removing common AI writing patterns. It focuses on local processing and structured data extraction for e-commerce and document workflows.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, sourced from binaries and bytecode. It serves as a reliable distribution point for developers who require automated updates and Nix-based package management for their agent tools.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing Hermes to operate directly on mobile hardware.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This tool uses a proot-distro Ubuntu environment within Termux to facilitate an automated installation of Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup and shell command execution, compatible with both external providers and local Ollama instances.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, featuring configurable gateway modes with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS via Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks through cron jobs on mobile devices.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project focuses on hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while providing configurable security policies for messaging and web search.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora acts as a self-hosted control plane for deploying and monitoring Hermes agents across Docker and Kubernetes. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, 17+ LLM provider integrations, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This repository provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes official Hermes installations and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible, declarative deployments of Hermes with secure secrets integration via sops-nix. It offers a hybrid skill management system that supports both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills within a single environment.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to manage multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It uniquely supports inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access for external clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs without a graphical interface.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python 3.12, PortableGit, and Sysinternals tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated or offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to conduct fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis for financial trading. It utilizes structured debates between bullish and bearish researchers to assess risk and supports multiple LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and DeepSeek.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking across multi-agent workflows. Users can manage agents via a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js installation or Docker deployment.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code, through TUI and web dashboards. It features container-based isolation, Git worktree management, and persistent sessions via tmux for background execution.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine is the first to manage Hermes agents on the Solana blockchain using the Claude-style MCP protocol. It detects HTTP signals to handle payment-required states for paid APIs and supports scaling from single VPS agents to orchestrated teams.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from a single instance to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for technical operations such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This orchestration tool enables the creation of autonomous swarms with durable memory and visual org charts for team delegation. It supports over 23 LLM providers and integrates MCP tools to expand agent capabilities.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and human-in-the-loop verification. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution to facilitate the review of task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across a strict pipeline architecture for research, planning, and infrastructure tasks. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination of these agents to ensure structured project implementation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Hermes Kanban board.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-optimization framework automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to battle for GitHub stars. It utilizes Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack using Hermes for task routing and tool-calling on consumer GPUs. It is optimized for RTX 4080/5080 hardware and runs via Ollama to eliminate cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage for coding agents by pre-indexing symbols and callers. It maintains an auto-syncing index of file changes and includes a browser-based UI for visualizing code relationships.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A CLI utility designed to track token consumption and associated costs across multiple AI coding agents. It features a 3D visualization dashboard and allows users to submit usage data to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from various coding agents while automatically redacting authentication headers. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions to facilitate detailed traffic analysis.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: A real-time widget that monitors token usage, costs, and rate limits across more than 36 AI tools by reading agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and provides historical data breakdowns by project or session.
entries.bergside/typeui: This project offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with major agents and providers that support markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents to build and operate applications. It loads 36 skills and six distinct workflows, supporting autonomous execution on both laptops and virtual private servers.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This customization tool provides community-developed themes and skins for the terminal interface, including retro and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can configure banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art through YAML-based settings.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: A native port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel that operates without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: A social economy platform that enables autonomous agents to communicate via encrypted Signal Protocol messaging using human-readable handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce through Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser built for autonomous control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing agent workflows. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports integration with chat platforms like Telegram and Slack as well as development environments.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: A preconfigured setup that utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve reported token savings of 90-99%. It includes over 40 skills for finance and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents using per-folder configurations and local skills. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while supporting project-specific memories, tools, and custom instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of hermes-agent and over 12 supporting services at zero cost using free models. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter for AI agent configurations that flags vague tool descriptions and missing stop conditions using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs bounded pairwise checks for tool differentiation and integrates with CI workflows through SARIF report generation.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility moves SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent formats. It maps existing credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON structures while setting up necessary systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool provides real-time telemetry for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It uses a native Hermes plugin to monitor performance drift against config-aware baselines through both passive analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This project provides a deterministic, zero-network local runtime designed to help users generate revenue using Hermes Agent. It features a bounded JSON/stdin adapter and requires explicit user approval for all external actions and spending.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: A voice-enabled assistant that provides an offline, open-mic interface for Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages, adaptive turn-taking, and barge-in capabilities using Piper and Kokoro.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search capabilities. It includes a dedicated circuit breaker for MemOS API outages and provides specific tools for searching, adding, and deleting memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application featuring a built-in agent engine with full file read and write access. It enables 24/7 automation via Cron and supports remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed with Python and vanilla JavaScript, this interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from web browsers or mobile devices. It features a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard manages AI chat sessions across ten communication platforms and supports visual workflows with approval gates. It includes features for scheduled jobs, usage analytics, and profile-aware model selection.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a skills manager with an MCP catalog.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents into a single workspace available as a desktop app, standalone server, or mobile client. It allows for the registration of any ACP-compatible agent for collaborative coding.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes native views for Kanban boards and cron jobs alongside an embedded terminal for shell access and system repair.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core kernel with health check capabilities. The UI supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering for chat and memory management.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects browser context to local or remote Hermes runtimes. It features intelligent tab scoping, group chats, and opt-in browser control via explicit approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent directly from their mobile device. It pairs with a hermes-webui server to manage agent chat, scheduled tasks, and server files without third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines while providing custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It includes a tmux operator view designed for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It features the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: This native macOS session browser tracks live Codex and Claude quota burn and estimated API costs for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It builds local search indexes to query prompts, tool calls, and command outputs without uploading telemetry or session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface designed for Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts that enables one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on fresh cloud computers. The workspace integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It specifically includes an approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: This alternative TUI and dashboard, built with OpenTUI, provides an interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It supports task management through a kanban board and allows users to manage profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features a terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application runs with embedded Python and Node.js runtimes, requiring no installation or admin rights. It features a Tkinter GUI with granular permission controls and includes 100 tools for TTS, music generation, and ComfyUI automation.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers, complemented by an integrated file browser.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This dashboard focuses on process monitoring, offering real-time session activity and cost tracking. It allows for the full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for runtime control. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
